map.输入六项污染物浓度，按 HJ 633-2012 标准逐项计算 IAQI 并取最大: Enter the six pollutant concentrations; per the HJ 633-2012 standard, compute the IAQI for each and take the maximum to get the AQI. Units: μg/m³ (CO in mg/m³).
map.📖 查看「空气质量AQI计算 使用指南」: 📖 View the "Air Quality AQI Calculation User Guide"
map.AQI = 逐污染物分段线性插值: AQI = piecewise linear interpolation per pollutant
map.💡 公式：IAQI = (IAQI高 - IAQI低)/(C高 - C低) ×: 💡 Formula: IAQI = (IAQI_high − IAQI_low)/(C_high − C_low) × (C − C_low) + IAQI_low; AQI = max(IAQI of each pollutant), and the primary pollutant is the one with the largest IAQI.
map.采用中国《环境空气质量指数（AQI）技术规定（试行）》HJ 633-2012 分: Uses the concentration breakpoints of China's "Technical Regulation on Ambient Air Quality Index (AQI) (on trial)" HJ 633-2012
map.O₃ 浓度超过 200 μg/m³ 时，1 小时 IAQI 参考分段外推计算，结: When the O₃ concentration exceeds 200 μg/m³, the 1-hour IAQI is extrapolated from the breakpoints for reference only
map.计算结果仅供参考，实际空气质量以官方监测发布为准: The calculated results are for reference only; actual air quality is subject to official monitoring releases
map.由 PM2.5/PM10/SO₂ 等浓度算 IAQI 分指数取最大得 AQI。: Compute the IAQI sub-index from PM2.5/PM10/SO₂ etc. and take the maximum to get the AQI.
map.识别首要污染物与超标等级。: Identify the primary pollutant and the exceedance grade.
map.对照 AQI 给健康出行建议。: Give health and outdoor-activity advice based on the AQI.
map.PM2.5=75 μg/m³：落在分段(35,75]→(50,100)，IAQI: PM2.5=75 μg/m³: falls in the segment (35,75]→(50,100), IAQI=50+(75−35)/(75−35)×(100−50)=100; PM10=50→IAQI=50. AQI=max=100 (Good), primary pollutant PM2.5.
map.PM2.5=35、PM10=50 时各 IAQI=50，AQI=50（优），无首: With PM2.5=35 and PM10=50, each IAQI=50, AQI=50 (Excellent), no primary pollutant, normal outdoor activity is fine.
map.AQI 为什么取最大值？: Why does the AQI take the maximum?
map.AQI 取各污染物 IAQI 的最大值，代表「最差那项」对健康的风险，首要污染物: The AQI takes the maximum IAQI across pollutants, representing the health risk of the "worst" one, which is the primary pollutant.
map.AQI 分几级？: How many AQI levels are there?
map.0–50 优、51–100 良、101–150 轻度、151–200 中度、20: 0-50 Excellent, 51-100 Good, 101-150 Light, 151-200 Moderate, 201-300 Heavy, >300 Severe; sensitive groups should take care above 100.
map.空气质量指数（AQI）计算器依据中国 HJ 633-2012 标准，输入 PM2: Based on China's HJ 633-2012 standard, the Air Quality Index (AQI) calculator takes the six pollutant concentrations PM2.5, PM10, SO₂, NO₂, CO and O₃, computes the individual air quality sub-index (IAQI) for each, takes the maximum as the AQI, and identifies the primary pollutant and its corresponding health impact grade.
